```plato

    // Restricts x to the inclusive range [lower, upper] using the total order.
    // Assumes lower <= upper.
    Clamp(x: IOrderable, lower: IOrderable, upper: IOrderable): IOrderable
        => x.Greater(lower).Lesser(upper);
```
